reply.text: {"say":"Back and legs, built for muscle: squats and a Romanian deadlift lead the legs, then rows and pulldowns cover the back.","title":"Back & Legs","days":[{"name":"Back & Legs","exercises":[{"key":"barbell-back-squat","sets":4,"reps":6,"repsTo":10,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Brace hard, hit depth every rep.\u00a0"},{"key":"barbell-romanian-deadlift","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":10,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Hips back, bar close to the legs."},{"key":"barbell-bent-over-row","sets":4,"reps":6,"repsTo":10,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Pull to the lower ribs."},{"key":"cable-lat-pulldown","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Drive elbows down to your sides."},{"key":"dumbbell-bulgarian-split-squat","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Control the descent, front foot flat."},{"key":"chest-supported-row-machine","sets":3,"reps":10,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Squeeze shoulder blades at the top."},{"key":"lying-leg-curl-machine","sets":3,"reps":10,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Slow lowering."}]}],"unmet":[]}
